title: Failing migrations after update

body:
### Description

I regualry pull the latest image of synapse. I did this recently but my server won't come up again.
It seems there are a bunch of related issues regarding db migrations recently. It seems I'm affected by this too but could not find my specific error here.

Coming from https://github.com/matrix-org/synapse/issues/13193#issuecomment-1191847014 I already tried to execute the command manually but it seems I have somewhat corrupted data.

### Steps to reproduce

start synapse (in Docker container)

### Homeserver

private homeserver

### Synapse Version

latest

### Installation Method

Docker (matrixdotorg/synapse)

### Platform

Linux
